name: Steinberg Cubase
note: Every row of the "Default Key Commands" section of the Cubase Pro 14 Operation Manual on steinberg.help. That section has one page per key command category; the category is used as the context (Add Track, Audio, Automation, Chords, Devices (Studio), Direct Offline Processing, Edit, Editors, File, Focus, Marker, Media, MIDI, MixConsole History, Navigate, Nudge, Project, Quantize, Set Insert Length, Tool, Track Versions, Transport, Window Zones, Workspaces, Zoom), and the action name is the manual's own Option column. Steinberg's convention page states that it writes the Windows modifier first and the macOS modifier second, so "Ctrl/Cmd-Z" is Ctrl+Z on Windows and Cmd+Z on macOS and "Alt/Opt" is Alt on both; that is how the two platforms here were filled in. Where a row lists alternatives ("Ctrl/Cmd-Alt/Opt-L or Alt/Opt-I", "Delete or Backspace") the first is kept; where it gives a range ("Ctrl/Cmd-3 to 9") it is split into one action per key with the key appended to the name in parentheses. Left out because the grammar has no numpad keys: every row whose key the manual writes as "Num ..." - the Transport rows Record, Stop, Rewind, Forward, Fast Rewind, Fast Forward, Cycle, Go to Left/Right Locator, Set Left/Right Locator to Project Cursor Position, Nudge Cursor Left/Right, Go to Project Start, Recall Cycle Marker 1 to 9 and MIDI Retrospective Record, the five MediaBay Open/Close rows plus Preview Cycle On/Off and Preview Stop, and all four Workspaces rows.
